title: How a wave of startups are betting on AI to make formal software verification practical and essential, including &Truth, which launches with a $70M seed (Paresh Dave/Wired)
summary: Paresh Dave / Wired: How a wave of startups are betting on AI to make formal software verification practical and essential, including &Truth, which launches with a $70M seed — A new startup called &Truth is joining the race to automate formal verification, a painstaking process that uses math to prove software works as intended.
